cook.doneCount: {n, plural, =0 {No steps done} =1 {1 of {total} steps done} other {# of {total} steps done}}
cook.noSteps: This recipe has no steps for cook mode yet.
cook.hint: Tip: swipe sideways or use the arrow keys to change steps. Steps you mark stay saved on this device for 24 hours.

ingredients.title: Ingredients
ingredients.scaled: Adjusted to {n, plural, =1 {1 serving} other {# servings}} (the recipe makes {base})

timer.finishedAlert: The timer for step {n} is done.
timer.background: The timer uses the end time, so it stays right with the screen locked or the app in the background. When it ends, the alarm rings again every 5 seconds, for up to 2 minutes, until you stop it. If the device pauses the page, the alarm rings when you come back.

wake.label: Keep the screen on
wake.active: The screen won't turn off while cook mode is open.
wake.off: The screen may turn off on its own.
wake.unsupported: This browser can't keep the screen on. Tap the screen now and then or increase your device's auto-lock time.
wake.denied: The browser didn't allow keeping the screen on right now (for example, in battery saver mode). Tap the screen now and then.

complete.title: All done?
complete.description: Mark the recipe as completed to record it in your progress.
complete.error: We couldn't complete the recipe right now. Please try again.

collection.title: My recipe collection
collection.description: Recipes you saved, your lists with recipes and, if you want, the ones you viewed last.

saved.emptyDescription: Tap the heart on a recipe page to keep it here.
saved.emptyCategory: No saved recipes in this category.
saved.confirmDescription: “{title}” leaves your collection. To keep it again, tap the heart on the recipe page.

lists.emptyDescription: Use the lists button on a recipe page to organize it in one of your lists.
lists.others: {n, plural, =1 {You have 1 more list without recipes.} other {You have # more lists without recipes.}}

history.title: Recently viewed recipes
history.consent: Off by default. If you turn it on, we only keep the date you last opened each recipe, to show it here. Only you can see it. Each entry is deleted after 90 days, and turning it off deletes everything right away.
history.clearDescription: This deletes every viewed recipe from this list. The history stays on for your next visits.
history.disableDescription: This deletes the history: every viewed recipe disappears from this list, and new visits aren't kept until you turn it on again.
history.enabledToast: History on. The next recipes you open will show up here.
history.offDescription: No viewed recipes are kept. Turn it on above if you want to revisit the last ones you opened.
history.emptyDescription: Open a recipe and it shows up in this list.
history.unavailableDescription: The recipe history isn't available in this environment yet.

errors.generic: We couldn't finish that right now. Please try again.
errors.history_unavailable: The recipe history isn't available yet.
